title: A Distribution-Matching Perspective on LLM Training Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2610.33740v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this work, we propose a unified framework for training algorithms across different stages of modern large language model development, based on the perspective of distribution matching. We show that a broad class of language model training algorithms can be interpreted as minimizing a certain divergence between the current model and a target distribution, and that characterizing the properties of this target distribution provides substantial insight into the behavior of the corresponding training algorithms. By analyzing specific forms of the target distribution, we establish that On-Policy Distillation (OPD) enjoys an advantage over classical Knowledge Distillation (KD) when the current model distribution is close to the target distribution, while exhibiting a disadvantage when the two distributions are far apart. translated_title: 大语言模型训练算法的分布匹配视角
translated_abstract: 在本工作中，我们从分布匹配的视角出发，提出了一个涵盖现代大语言模型开发各个阶段训练算法的统一框架。我们证明，广泛的一类语言模型训练算法都可以被解释为最小化当前模型与某个目标分布之间的某种散度，而对这一目标分布性质的刻画能够为理解相应训练算法的行为提供深刻的洞见。通过分析目标分布的具体形式，我们证明了当当前模型分布接近目标分布时，在线策略蒸馏（OPD）相较于经典的知识蒸馏（KD）具有优势，而当两个分布相距较远时则表现出劣势。此外，当目标分布本身依赖于被优化的模型时，我们证明了……的累积（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出以分布匹配为统一视角解释大语言模型各阶段的训练算法，揭示出在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在当前模型分布接近目标分布时优于经典知识蒸馏（KD）、而在两者分布差异较大时则处于劣势的规律。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified distribution-matching framework for interpreting LLM training algorithms, revealing that On-Policy Distillation (OPD) outperforms classical Knowledge Distillation (KD) when the current model distribution is close to the target distribution, but underperforms when the two distributions are far apart.
